connect.desc: Connect to an externally deployed Dify instance (this entity is a bridge, not an installer)
connect.hint: Point to the Dify nginx entry (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8899). Connecting probes reachability; uninitialized self-hosted instances get an auto-created admin. No Dify yet? Ask the AI to deploy it with its ops/SSH abilities, then connect here.
connect.adminDesc: Admin account auto-created by the entity or entered manually
connect.adminHint: Use this email and password to sign in to the native Dify console for manual editing; the password is stored masked in the entity secrets.json.

confirm.deleteMsg: This deletes "{{name}}" (irreversible; local API keys and MCP bridge are cleaned up too). Continue?
confirm.mcpDisableMsg: This disables the MCP server of "{{name}}" and removes its tool registration from Anelf. Continue?

admin.modalDesc: Credentials are verified with a real login before being saved. Enter them here to take over an already-initialized instance; for uninitialized ones just click Connect to auto-create.
admin.passwordKeepHint: Leave ******** unchanged to keep the saved password

apps.title: Applications
apps.empty: No apps yet — use Create or Import DSL above
apps.importNamePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the name inside the DSL

run.title: Run & Debug

models.title: Model Providers

mcp.title: MCP Bridge
mcp.desc: Expose a Dify app as an MCP server and auto-register it into Anelf so the AI can call it directly
